name: Siam Welcome Discount Popup
author: Sharafat Siam

sections.description:
Siam Welcome Discount Popup displays a promotional popup only for first-time visitors.

This is helpful for WooCommerce store owners who want to offer a welcome discount or coupon to new visitors. The popup appears once and includes:

  • Discount percentage
  • Coupon code
  • One-click copy button

The popup does NOT show again after the first visit, ensuring a smooth user experience without annoying repeat popups.

This plugin helps you:

  • Encourage new customers to make their first purchase
  • Promote limited-time or welcome offers
  • Increase conversions and sales
  • Improve visitor engagement

It is lightweight, easy to configure, and works instantly after activation.

Features

  • Popup shown only once per visitor
  • Great for WooCommerce discount promotions
  • Easy copy-to-clipboard coupon button
  • Clean, modern popup UI
  • Customizable text, coupon, and discount
  • Change popup title and subtitle
  • Mobile-responsive design
  • Lightweight and fast
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin via Plugins → Installed Plugins.
  3. Go to Discount Popup → Settings in your WordPress dashboard.
  4. Enter your coupon code, discount amount, and popup text.
  5. Save settings — the popup will now appear for first-time visitors.
sections.faq:
Does the popup appear every time?

No. It appears only once for each new visitor.

Does this work with WooCommerce coupons?

Yes. You can create a WooCommerce coupon and display it in the popup.

Can I customize the popup text?

Yes, you can change the title, subtitle, discount, and coupon code in the settings.
